title: Concept: Possible a gradle.properties nexusPassword entry in source
description: a gradle.properties nexusPassword entry is a credential stored in a tool-specific file. Because the format is plain text, every clone, backup and artifact copy carries the credential until it is rotated and the file is provisioned at run time.
applicability: Configuration files, credential files and deploy templates that may contain a gradle.properties nexusPassword entry.
risk: Use of the credential by anyone who can read a clone or an artifact; HIGH severity.
